stateEncoding.rule: Style may visually implement only carriers and values explicitly defined by the owning upstream presentation or subsystem contract

rules: Style consumes class and attribute semantics; it does not invent them
WebGUI owns primitive and component class semantics
WebEngine owns application and composition class semantics
Style must not style an undeclared shared .wg-* or .we-* selector
Style must not assign meaning to an undeclared shared state/status/variant value
domains compose the public contracts instead of creating a parallel shared design system
presentation state is never authorization authority
